# Ducks transported: 10b+8c>=300
# Minimize time: 20b+40c
problem={'b': {'lower':0,'upper':12,'type':'int'},'c':{'lower':0,'type':'int'}}
# constraints as list of dicts
constraints=[
 {'lhs':{'b':2,'c':-3},'rhs':0,'op':'>='}, # 2c-3b>=0
 {'lhs':{'b':10,'c':8},'rhs':300,'op':'>='}]
objective={'lhs':{'b':20,'c':40},'sense':'min'}
problem['objective']=objective
problem['constraints']=constraints
print(solve('model',problem))
"}
